plainText:
Marc Thompson is an American voice actor for the English dub of and . He is currently affiliated with Innovative Artists.

==Biography==
Thompson was born on May 20, 1975, in Webster, New York. In 1997, he graduated from the Tisch School at New York University and pursued a voice acting career afterwards. Thompson began voicing characters in the in the middle of . He provided many minor and additional voices until 4Kids Entertainment gave up the dubbing and distribution of the series to and TAJ Productions.

Thompson returned to in Journey to the Unown!, where he provided the voice of Saturn. In , he gained many important roles in the series, particularly those of Don George, the Unova Pokédex, Ash's Pignite and , and Dr. Zager. In , he voiced Remo, as well as Ash's Noibat and . His roster of major roles expanded even further during , where he gained the roles of Samson Oak and Kiawe's Turtonator. Besides doing voice-over work, Thompson is a minister in the International Churches of Christ - New York Chapter.
